zh-hant.title: 聖經金句平安16節｜基督所賜的平安與默想
zh-hant.description: 從約翰福音14:27到民數記6:26，16節關於神所賜平安的經文，分四組附默想，經文引自和合本。
zh-hant.h1: 聖經金句平安：基督所賜的平安與16節經文
zh-hant.intro: 聖經所說的平安，源自希伯來文的「沙龍」（shalom），意思不只是心情安靜，而是與神和好、整個人得以完整安穩。耶穌在約翰福音 14:27 說，祂賜的平安不像世人所賜的。下面十六節經文分成四組：基督賜下的平安、神所保守的心、祝福裡的平安，以及與人和睦。若你正為某件事焦慮，可以先讀「焦慮」那一頁；這裡要談的是平安從哪裡來、如何持守。

groups.heading: 耶穌留下的平安，與神和好
groups.reflection: 約翰福音 14:27 是耶穌被捕前夕在樓房裡對門徒說的話，他們即將面對離別與驚慌，祂卻說要留下自己的平安。羅馬書 5:1 解釋這平安的根基：因信稱義，與神和好。以弗所書 2:14 是保羅對猶太人與外邦信徒說的，基督拆毀了隔斷的牆。歌羅西書 3:15 則請我們讓基督的平安在心裡作主，意思是遇到抉擇時，讓祂來當裁判。

groups.heading: 神所保守的心懷意念
groups.reflection: 腓立比書是保羅在獄中寫給教會的信，他說神的平安「出人意外」，在基督耶穌裡保守我們的心。以賽亞書 26:3 出自猶大百姓盼望得救的詩歌，應許堅心倚靠神的人必得十分平安。羅馬書 15:13 是保羅對羅馬教會的祝禱，指出喜樂與平安來自盼望的神。詩篇 29:11 是大衛在雷電風暴的描寫之後，說耶和華以平安賜福給祂的百姓。

groups.heading: 祝福裡的平安：從沙龍到平安的君
groups.reflection: 民數記 6:24-26 是耶和華吩咐摩西，讓亞倫和他的子孫用來為以色列人祝福的話，最後一句正是「賜你平安」。以賽亞書 9:6 預言將來有一嬰孩降生，稱為「和平的君」，後來基督徒相信這應驗在耶穌身上。詩篇 85:8 提醒我們，要先聽神說話；以賽亞書 32:17 則指出，公義的果效是平安，不是靠忽略問題換來的安靜。

groups.heading: 追求和睦，做使人和睦的人
groups.reflection: 有了神給的平安，也要活出來。耶穌在登山寶訓說，使人和睦的人有福，這是對跟隨祂的門徒說的。保羅在羅馬書 12:18 說得很實際：「若是能行」，也就是盡你所能，不是強求每段關係都修復。希伯來書 12:14 與詩篇 34:14 都把和睦當作要主動追趕的事，而不是等它自己出現。

faq.q: 聖經裡的平安是什麼意思？
faq.a: 舊約的「平安」多譯自希伯來文 shalom，指完整、安穩、與神與人關係和諧；新約則強調因信靠耶穌而與神和好（羅馬書 5:1）。它不等於沒有難處，而是在難處中仍有神同在。

faq.q: 心裡不平安的時候，可以讀哪些經文？
faq.a: 可以從約翰福音 14:27、腓立比書 4:6-7 與以賽亞書 26:3 開始，讀一節就好，再用一兩句話向神禱告。如果不安持續很久，也請找牧者或專業輔導陪伴。

faq.q: 「平安」和「安慰」的經文有什麼不同？
faq.a: 安慰經文多是在傷痛中被神陪伴，平安經文多談與神和好，以及心被保守、與人和睦。兩者常相連，若你正在流淚，可以參考「聖經安慰經文」那一頁。

faq.q: 適合用來祝福別人的平安經文有哪些？
faq.a: 民數記 6:24-26 是聖經中的祝福禱詞，教會常在崇拜結束時使用；羅馬書 15:13 也很適合寫在卡片上送給朋友。

en.title: 16 Bible Verses for Peace of Mind (With Reflections)
en.description: Sixteen Bible verses for peace of mind, from John 14:27 to Isaiah 26:3, in four groups with short reflections on who wrote them and why. BSB text.
en.h1: Bible Verses for Peace of Mind: 16 Scriptures to Settle Your Heart
en.intro: Peace of mind, in the Bible, is a gift from God that guards a worried heart. It is not the same as having no problems. The Hebrew word shalom means wholeness and well-being, and Jesus says in John 14:27 that the peace he gives is not the kind the world gives. These 16 verses are in four groups: peace from Christ, a mind God keeps steady, peace spoken as a blessing, and peace with other people. If worry is the main thing, start with our anxiety page. This one is about where peace comes from and how to hold onto it.

groups.heading: Peace Jesus leaves with you
groups.reflection: John 14:27 comes from Jesus' last evening with his disciples, hours before his arrest. He knew they were about to be scared, and he gave them peace anyway. Romans 5:1 says where it is anchored: being made right with God by faith. Ephesians 2:14 is Paul writing to Jews and Gentiles who had been divided, saying Christ is their peace. Colossians 3:15 then makes it practical. Let that peace act as umpire when your thoughts pull in different directions.

groups.heading: A mind God keeps steady
groups.reflection: Paul wrote Philippians from prison, and he calls God's peace something that goes beyond understanding. It guards your heart and mind, like a sentry. Isaiah 26:3 is part of a song Judah sings about trusting God, and it promises perfect peace to a mind fixed on him. Romans 15:13 is Paul's blessing for the church in Rome. Psalm 29:11 follows David's picture of a violent storm: the same Lord who is that strong blesses his people with peace.

groups.heading: Peace spoken as a blessing
groups.reflection: Numbers 6:24-26 is the blessing God told Moses to give Aaron and his sons to speak over Israel, and it ends with peace. Isaiah 9:6 names a coming child Prince of Peace, a title Christians apply to Jesus. Psalm 85:8 is a small habit worth copying: listen first for what God will say. Isaiah 32:17 adds that lasting peace is the fruit of righteousness, not of ignoring what is wrong.

groups.heading: Peace with the people around you
groups.reflection: Inner calm is hard to keep while a relationship is at war. Jesus says in the Sermon on the Mount that peacemakers are blessed, and he says it to his followers, not to the crowd. Paul's words in Romans 12:18 are honest: as far as it depends on you. You are not responsible for the other person's side. Hebrews 12:14 and Psalm 34:14 both treat peace as something to chase, not wait for.

faq.q: What Bible verse is best for peace of mind?
faq.a: Philippians 4:6-7 is a good place to start. Paul says to bring everything to God in prayer with thanks, and God's peace will guard your heart and mind. John 14:27 and Isaiah 26:3 are close second choices.

faq.q: What does the Bible mean by peace?
faq.a: In the Old Testament, peace usually translates shalom: wholeness, safety and right relationship with God and others. In the New Testament it centers on being reconciled to God through Jesus (Romans 5:1). It is not the absence of trouble.

faq.q: What should I read when I can't feel peace?
faq.a: Pick one verse, such as Isaiah 26:3 or John 14:27, and read it slowly, then pray in one or two sentences. If the unrest lasts for weeks, talk to a pastor or a counselor. Scripture and care can go together.

faq.q: Which verses help with peace and anxiety together?
faq.a: Philippians 4:6-7, 1 Peter 5:7 and Matthew 6:34 pair peace with worry. You will find more, with reflections, on our page of Bible verses for anxiety.
